subject: general
question: The months of ________ form a period of transition from hot rainy season to dry winter conditions.
solution:
The correct answer is __**October-November.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **October-November** is the period when the** monsoon season** gradually comes to an **end,** and the** winter season begins** in most parts of India.
 
• **During this period, the temperature starts to drop, and the humidity level also decreases, making the weather pleasant and comfortable.**
 
• The transition from hot and humid weather to dry and cool weather is gradual and can be observed in the changing landscape, such as the foliage and the sky.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **September-October is still a part of the monsoon season and receives heavy rainfall.**
 
• **December-January is already the peak of the winter season with low temperatures and no rainfall.**
 
• The word transition means a process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.
 
• In this context, it refers to the change in weather conditions from hot and rainy to dry and cool.
